method: Aggregate statistics only. Queries request counts, sums, and lot-size bins. Owner names, mailing addresses, and parcel identifiers are never requested or stored.

CT.source: Connecticut CAMA and Parcel Layer, services3.arcgis.com Connecticut_CAMA_and_Parcel_Layer
CT.area_field_note: Land_Acres is rounded to integers in this layer, so bins use Shape__Area, which matches square-foot magnitudes (mean near one acre).

WI.source: Wisconsin Statewide Parcels DB V1200 (2026), services3.arcgis.com Wisconsin_Statewide_Parcels_DB. Improved PROPCLASS 1 (residential) with GIS acres.
WI.area_field_note: Class 1 is residential, not detached single-family only. The model caps eligible homes at the ACS single-family stock so apartments inside Class 1 are not treated as ADU lots.

UT.source: Utah Housing Unit Inventory, services1.arcgis.com HousingUnitInventory. Urban-county derivative of assessor parcels, not the full statewide SGID parcel layer.
UT.area_field_note: Mean single-family lot is 0.512 acres. Feasibility uses a documented lognormal tail because the service did not return percentile bins in this build.

HI.source: Hawaii Statewide TMKs (MapServer layer 25) and State Land Use Districts (layer 20) on geodata.hawaii.gov ParcelsZoning.
HI.area_field_note: The parcel layer has no normalized zoning class. The binding tier-1 fact used by the model is the State Land Use Urban share of land. Housing eligibility uses geography_eligible_share, the assumed share of the single-family stock inside that district.
